metadata.name: noised_launchpad
metadata.description: Noised launchpad: Meteora DBC launches attested on-chain by the creator's post-quantum (LMS) identity, with no admin key, a fair-open batch and immutable fee routing

instructions.name: attest_launch
docs: Land an LMS signature by a post-quantum identity over a launch's
configuration, metadata record (`metadata_hash`), creator rules
(`rules_hash`, zero for none) and launch window, burning its leaf;
the first by the launch's identity that `launch` can use attests it,
and so does a later one once the attested window has ended while the
launch is still Configured (permissionless; the signature
authorizes).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone (in practice a throwaway key): pays the fee and, the first
time, the rent of the identity and attestation accounts.

accounts.name: launch
docs: Any launch, in any status: a signature over its message stays
landable forever.

accounts.name: identity
docs: The signing identity, `["identity", SHA256(0x21 || lms_pk)]`: created
by the first of its signatures that lands (an account pre-funded by
anyone is taken over).

accounts.name: attestation
docs: Written by an attesting signature: the first, or one replacing an
attestation whose window ended while the launch was Configured.
Never changes once the launch is Live.

accounts.name: token_meta
docs: launch, metadata_hash]`: the handler refuses any other address
(`ConstraintSeeds`). Its content is unchecked, so that a valid
signature lands whatever is (or is not) at this address; the handler
attests only if it is that record (`pq::is_metadata_record`).

accounts.name: rules
docs: launch, rules_hash]`, or none (the program id) for the zero hash: the
handler refuses anything else (`ConstraintSeeds`). Its content is
unchecked, as for `token_meta`; the handler attests only if it is
that record (`pq::is_rules_record`).

docs: Pay out one commit (permissionless; funds go only to the commit's
recorded payout owners).

docs: Claim DBC partner trading fees into the launch authority (permissionless).

accounts.name: payer

instructions.name: claim_lp_fees
docs: Claim DAMM v2 LP position fees after migration (permissionless).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone; pays for the launch authority's token accounts if missing.

accounts.name: damm_pool
docs: checked in the handler (`checks::verify_lp_position`).

accounts.name: position
docs: in the handler (`checks::verify_lp_position`).

accounts.name: position_nft_account
docs: The position NFT, held by the launch authority.

instructions.name: claim_surplus
docs: Withdraw DBC partner and creator surplus after the curve completes (permissionless).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone; pays for the launch authority's wSOL account if missing.

accounts.name: pool
docs: checked when its surplus flags are read).

instructions.name: commit
docs: Commit wSOL to the fair-open batch.

accounts.name: token_owner
docs: base mint (checked on the first commit, then fixed).

accounts.name: refund_owner
docs: wSOL (checked on the first commit, then fixed).

docs: `["payout-vault", launch, token_owner]`, when `token_owner` is a

instructions.name: create_launch
docs: Validate `params` and create the launch's DBC transfer-hook config.

accounts.name: launch
docs: `["launch", creator, launch_seed]`: a creator's own address space,
so nobody can take the address another creator's launch is meant for.

instructions.name: distribute
docs: Route collected wSOL fees and burn collected base tokens (permissionless).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone; pays for missing token accounts.

accounts.name: base_mint
docs: Writable: burning reduces supply.

accounts.name: treasury_quote_ata
docs: (same rules as recipient ATAs, see `AtaCreator::ensure`).

instructions.name: execute_batch
docs: Execute the batch buy (permissionless, once, in the execution window).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone; pays for the batch base escrow if it does not exist yet.

accounts.name: base_mint
docs: Writable: DBC revokes the hook here if this swap completes the curve.

accounts.name: policy
docs: under the hook program, which owns, checks and writes it: its shield
ends once the batch has bought. Writable in the transaction (it is
also among the swap's read-only hook accounts).

instructions.name: initialize_protocol
docs: One-time: set the treasury (a wSOL PQ vault) and platform fee share.
Upgrade authority only.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: handler by owner, discriminator, version and mint).

instructions.name: launch
docs: Create the pool and mint from the attested metadata record, install
the hook policy with the attested rules, write the certificate
(permissionless, inside the attested launch window).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone, inside the attested window: pays the rent of the pool, mint,
policy and certificate.

accounts.name: dbc_config
docs: owner, type and every fixed value are re-checked after the pool CPI.

accounts.name: base_mint
docs: Fresh mint keypair (the payer's choice); DBC creates the mint.

accounts.name: attestation
docs: This launch's post-quantum attestation (`attest_launch`); its fields
are checked against the launch, the metadata record and the clock in
the handler.

accounts.name: token_meta
docs: The metadata record the attestation names (`publish_metadata`): the
mint's name, symbol and uri come from it.

accounts.name: rules
docs: The rules record the attestation names (`publish_rules`), whose bytes
the hook policy gets; none (the program id) when the attested rules
hash is zero.

instructions.name: pq_authorize
docs: Land an LMS signature by a post-quantum identity authorizing `kind`
over `payload_hash` for a launch, burning its leaf; the first by the
launch's identity writes the `Authorization` (permissionless; the
signature authorizes).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone (in practice a throwaway key): pays the fee and, the first
time, the rent of the identity and authorization accounts.

accounts.name: launch
docs: Any launch, in any status: a signature over its message stays
landable forever.

accounts.name: identity
docs: The signing identity, `["identity", SHA256(0x21 || lms_pk)]`, shared
with `attest_launch`: created by the first of its signatures that
lands (an account pre-funded by anyone is taken over).

accounts.name: authorization
docs: Written whole by the first authorizing signature; never changes.

instructions.name: publish_metadata
docs: Write a launch's metadata record whole, at the address its content
hashes to (permissionless, idempotent, while the launch is
configured).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone (in practice the throwaway key of the attestation): pays the
fee and the record's rent.

accounts.name: launch
docs: The launch the record is for; records are published before it goes
live.

accounts.name: token_meta
docs: The record, at the address its content hashes to: created whole here
(an account pre-funded by anyone is taken over), or already there
with exactly this content.

instructions.name: publish_rules
docs: Write a launch's creator rules (PXR1) whole, at the address their
bytes hash to, once they verify for its guard (permissionless,
idempotent, while the launch is configured).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone (in practice the throwaway key of the attestation): pays the
fee and the record's rent.

accounts.name: launch
docs: The launch the rules are for; rules are published before it goes
live, and verified for its guard.

accounts.name: rules
docs: The record, at the address its content hashes to: created whole here
(an account pre-funded by anyone is taken over), or already there
with exactly this content.

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority

errors.name: InvalidProtocolParams
errors.msg: Platform fee is above the maximum or the treasury is not a wSOL PQ vault

errors.name: InvalidDecimals
errors.msg: Token decimals must be 6..=9

errors.name: InvalidThreshold
errors.msg: Migration threshold must be 1..=100_000 SOL

errors.name: InvalidCurve

errors.name: InvalidBaseFee
errors.msg: Base fee must be a linear or exponential scheduler within DBC's bounds

errors.name: FeeScheduleTooLong
errors.msg: Fee schedule must end before the batch executes (duration <= open delay)

errors.name: InvalidDynamicFee
errors.msg: Dynamic fee parameters are outside DBC's bounds

errors.name: FeeTooHigh
errors.msg: Fee after the schedule (base + max dynamic) exceeds the safety ceiling

errors.name: InvalidMigrationFeeOption
errors.msg: Migration fee option must be 0..=5 (fixed DAMM v2 fee tiers)

errors.name: InvalidOpenDelay
errors.msg: Open delay must be 60..=1800 seconds

errors.name: InvalidGuard

errors.name: InvalidMaxWallet

errors.name: InvalidMaxBuy

errors.name: InvalidBatchCap

errors.name: InvalidRecipients

errors.name: InvalidMetadata

errors.name: WrongCreator

types.name: Attestation
docs: A launch's post-quantum attestation (PQ v2 §2.2), at
`["attestation", launch]`: a valid LMS signature by the launch's identity
over its attestation message (`pq::attestation_message`) whose metadata
record exists, whose rules record exists if it names one, and whose
window has a minute left when it lands, kept in
full so anyone can re-verify it from account state alone. A landing that
does not attest leaves it as it is: empty (version 0 and `launch`
default, with only its bump set), which `launch` refuses, or the
attestation already written. Written by the first attesting signature;
rewritten whole only by an attesting signature landing after its window
ended while the launch was still Configured (`attest_launch`); never
modified once the launch is Live (the certificate keeps the one `launch`
used), never closed.

fields.name: leaf
docs: The LMS leaf `q` that signed (< 1,024).

fields.name: metadata_hash
docs: `pq::metadata_hash_v2` of the metadata record the identity signed,
which names its `TokenMeta` (`["metadata", launch, metadata_hash]`);
`launch` uses only that record.

fields.name: rules_hash
docs: `noised_rules::rules_hash` of the creator rules the identity signed,
which names their `LaunchRules` (`["rules", launch, rules_hash]`);
all zero for none. `launch` installs exactly those rules.

fields.name: message_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the 221-byte attestation message.

fields.name: slot
docs: Slot the attestation landed in.

fields.name: not_before
docs: The launch window the identity signed (unix seconds, inclusive):
`launch` runs only inside it.

fields.name: signature
docs: The 2,508-byte LMS signature.

types.name: Authorization
docs: A post-quantum authorization (`pq_authorize`, programmable launches §2,
amendment A1), at `["auth", launch, [kind], payload_hash]`: a valid LMS
signature by the launch's identity over `pq::authorization_message`,
kept in full so anyone can re-verify it from account state alone.
Written once, by the first such signature (the account a landing that
does not authorize creates stays empty: version 0); never modified or
closed. The launchpad gives `kind` no meaning; the autopilot reads kinds
1 (GRAPH_ACTIVATE), 2 (GRAPH_FREEZE) and 3 (OPERATOR_REVOKE), by layout.

fields.name: pq_identity
docs: The launch's identity, which signed.

fields.name: payload_hash
docs: What is authorized (the consumer's payload hash).

fields.name: message_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the 140-byte authorization message.

fields.name: unix_time
docs: When it landed (`Clock`).

fields.name: leaf
docs: The LMS leaf that signed (< 1,024).

fields.name: signature
docs: The 2,508-byte LMS signature.

types.name: Authorized
docs: `pq_authorize` wrote an authorization by the launch's identity.

fields.name: authorization
docs: `["auth", launch, [kind], payload_hash]`.

types.name: BaseFeeParams
docs: DBC base fee. Only fee-scheduler modes are accepted: 0 linear, 1 exponential.
`first_factor` = number of periods, `second_factor` = period length in
seconds, `third_factor` = reduction factor.

fields.name: token_owner
docs: Where the tokens went (the canonical base-token ATA of this owner).

fields.name: refund_owner
docs: Where the refund went (the canonical wSOL ATA of this owner).

types.name: Certificate
docs: Immutable launch certificate (SPEC §1.5). Written once, never modified.

fields.name: creator
docs: Informational only: has no powers.

fields.name: checks
docs: `checks::*` bitflags; all are set on every certificate.

fields.name: snipe_shield_end_ts
docs: The scheduled end of the snipe shield (= `execute_end_ts`). When the
batch executes before it, the live policy's end becomes the moment of
the batch (`noised_hook::end_snipe_shield`); the certificate keeps
the schedule.

fields.name: pq_identity
docs: The post-quantum identity that attested this launch (`checks::PQ_ATTESTED`).

fields.name: pq_leaf
docs: The identity's LMS leaf that signed the attestation.

fields.name: attested_slot
docs: Slot of the attestation (`["attestation", launch]` holds the signature).

fields.name: metadata
docs: The `TokenMeta` record the identity attested, whose name, symbol and
derived uri the mint holds (`checks::METADATA_ONCHAIN`).

fields.name: rules_hash
docs: The creator rules the identity attested, which the hook policy
holds (`checks::RULES_BOUND`); all zero for none.

types.name: Commit
docs: One participant's fair-open batch commitment.

fields.name: token_owner
docs: Receives the tokens: `owner` itself or a PQ vault of the base mint.
Fixed by the first commit; `claim` pays only its canonical ATA.

fields.name: refund_owner
docs: Receives the wSOL refund: `owner` itself or a PQ vault of wSOL.
Fixed by the first commit; `claim` pays only its canonical ATA.

fields.name: quote_amount
docs: wSOL that arrived in the launch authority's account.

fields.name: surplus
docs: true for DBC surplus withdrawals, false for trading fees.

types.name: Identity
docs: A creator's post-quantum identity (PQ v2 §2.2): an LMS public key
(RFC 8554 `LMS_SHA256_M32_H10` over `LMOTS_SHA256_N32_W4`, 1,024 one-time
leaves) at `["identity", SHA256(0x21 || public_key)]`, and which of its
leaves have signed an attestation message that landed. A leaf is accepted
once, ever. Created by the first of its signatures that lands; never
closed.

fields.name: used
docs: Leaf `q` is used when `used[q >> 3] & (1 << (q & 7)) != 0`
(least significant bit first; see `pq::leaf_bit`).

fields.name: used_count
docs: Number of bits set in `used`.

types.name: Launch
docs: Per-launch state, at `["launch", creator, launch_seed]` (a launch's
address names its creator: nobody can take another creator's address).
Everything that shapes the launch is fixed at `create_launch`; later
instructions only advance the timeline and batch.

fields.name: creator
docs: Signed `create_launch`; part of the attestation message. It has no
powers afterwards: its post-quantum identity attests the launch and
anyone may then launch it inside the attested window.

fields.name: base_mint
docs: Default until `launch`.

fields.name: pool
docs: Default until `launch`.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Snapshots of the immutable `Protocol` taken at creation.

fields.name: recipients
docs: Unused slots are default with bps 0.

fields.name: batch_wallet_cap
docs: 0 = no per-wallet cap.

fields.name: batch_total_cap
docs: Resolved cap (a creator's 0 becomes the migration threshold).

fields.name: params_hash
docs: sha256 of the borsh-serialized `LaunchParams`.

fields.name: tokens_claimed
docs: Running totals that bound every payout (SPEC §7 invariant 4).

fields.name: pq_identity
docs: `LaunchParams::pq_identity`: the creator's post-quantum identity, the
SHA-256 name of its LMS public key. `launch` requires an attestation
signed by it.

types.name: LaunchAttested
docs: `attest_launch` recorded the launch's post-quantum attestation (the
first one, or one replacing an attestation whose window ended while the
launch was Configured).

fields.name: metadata_hash
docs: Names the attested `TokenMeta` (`["metadata", launch, metadata_hash]`).

fields.name: rules_hash
docs: Names the attested `LaunchRules` (`["rules", launch, rules_hash]`);
all zero for none.

fields.name: not_before
docs: The window `launch` may run in (unix seconds, inclusive).

types.name: LaunchParams
docs: Everything a creator chooses (SPEC §1.2). Field order is part of the
certificate's `params_hash`, so it must never change.

fields.name: pq_identity
docs: The creator's post-quantum identity: `SHA256(0x21 || LMS public key)`
(`noised_lmots::identity_id`), never all zero. `launch` runs only
after this identity attested the launch (`attest_launch`), inside the
window it signed.

types.name: LaunchRules
docs: A launch's creator rules (PXR1, `noised_rules::rules`), on-chain
(`publish_rules`), at `["rules", launch, rules_hash]` where `rules_hash =
noised_rules::rules_hash(bytes)`: the address is the content. Verified
against the launch's guard when written; the space is exactly the
content (`LaunchRules::space`). Created whole by one instruction (anyone
may pay), never modified or closed. Only the record an attestation names
(`Attestation::rules_hash`, then `Certificate::rules_hash`) is the
launch's.

fields.name: rules_hash
docs: The address's third seed, stored for readers.

fields.name: bytes
docs: The PXR1 bytes (at most 1,228).

types.name: MetadataPublished
docs: `publish_metadata` created a metadata record (not emitted when the record
already existed).

fields.name: token_meta
docs: `["metadata", launch, metadata_hash]`.

fields.name: uri_len
docs: Bytes of the record's uri and document.

types.name: PayoutVault
docs: `["payout-vault", launch, vault]`: what the commits naming the PQ vault
`vault` as their token owner have committed to `launch`, together. Claims
are exempt from the Launch Guard, so shares paid to one account would add
up past `max_wallet` and around `p2p_locked` while the guard runs:
`commit` holds this total to `batch_wallet_cap`, like one wallet's own
commit, so a vault never receives more than one wallet could. Created by
the first commit naming the vault; never closed.

fields.name: committed
docs: wSOL committed by every commit whose token owner is `vault`.

types.name: PqLeafConsumed
docs: `attest_launch` landed a valid signature that does not attest the launch:
the launch is attested and its window has not ended (or it is Live), or
the signing identity is not the one the launch names, or no metadata
record (or no rules record, for a non-zero rules hash) exists at the
address the signed hash names, or the signed window is one `launch`
could not use (not even a minute of it left). Or `pq_authorize` landed a
valid signature that does not authorize: another identity's, or a
second one of an authorization already written. Its leaf (of the
identity `pq_identity` that signed) is now used and can never sign
again.

types.name: Protocol
docs: Global, immutable after `initialize_protocol`.

types.name: RulesPublished
docs: `publish_rules` created a rules record (not emitted when the record
already existed).

fields.name: rules
docs: `["rules", launch, rules_hash]`.

fields.name: len
docs: Bytes of the PXR1 rule set.

types.name: TokenMeta
docs: A token's metadata, on-chain (`publish_metadata`), at
`["metadata", launch, metadata_hash]` where `metadata_hash =
pq::metadata_hash_v2(name, symbol, flags, uri, doc)`: the address is the
content, so nobody can put other bytes at an address an identity signed.
The space is exactly the content (`TokenMeta::space`). Created whole by
one instruction (anyone may pay), never modified or closed.
Anyone may publish records under any launch, each at its own address;
only the one an attestation names (`Attestation::metadata_hash`, then
`Certificate::metadata`) is the launch's. Readers resolve it through
those, never by searching for records of a launch.

fields.name: flags
docs: `META_FLAG_*`: how `launch` derives the mint's uri.

fields.name: metadata_hash
docs: The address's third seed, stored for readers.

fields.name: name
docs: UTF-8, 1..=32 bytes.

fields.name: symbol
docs: UTF-8, 1..=10 bytes.

fields.name: uri
docs: Empty unless `META_FLAG_EXTERNAL_URI`: then `https://`, printable
ASCII, at most 200 bytes.

fields.name: doc
docs: The metadata document (UTF-8, at most 3,072 bytes; the SDK writes
compact JSON). Not empty with `META_FLAG_INLINE_URI`.
